result:
The proposed answer is not correct. The solution gives no derivation. It just asserts a factor of $(q+1)^{n-2}$, and that factor does not match the known result.

From memory, I believe the known result (Lavrauw–Storme–Van de Voorde, on codes from points and lines in $\mathrm{PG}(n,q)$) is

$$d(n,q) = (d(2,q)-1)\,q^{n-2}+1.$$

I did not derive this here. It comes from a cone construction over a minimum-weight plane codeword, adjusted at the vertex. For $n=3$ it gives $(d(2,q)-1)q+1$, while the proposed formula gives $d(2,q)(q+1)$. These differ, since $d(2,q)(q+1) - \big((d(2,q)-1)q+1\big) = d(2,q) + q - 1 > 0$. The proposed value is therefore larger than the known minimum.

VERDICT: REJECT
